summary: Hand-authored internal/cdcpdf two-backend PDF text extractor with a macOS PDFKit subprocess bridge and a pure-Go fallback.
reason: CDC's penetration reports are the only per-security custody figures published in this market and they exist solely as PDFs. Three pure-Go PDF libraries were tried against the live 2025-11-30 vintage: all three either returned empty text or panicked on its xref stream. PDFKit via 'swift -e' reads it correctly, so the primary backend shells out and the pure-Go path stays as a fallback for non-Darwin hosts. extractPureGo wraps its call in recover() because the pure-Go library panics rather than erroring on a malformed xref. The reported page count is framed in \x01 delimiters so report text cannot spoof it, and readProducer decodes UTF-16BE BOMs.
validated_outcome: PDFKit backend extracts all four report layouts on the live vintage; Available() reports false off Darwin so the pure-Go path is exercised there. This is a genuine platform constraint and is stated in the README and PR.
